name: arm6309-hardware
description: Board layouts for the arm6309 machine

scripts.check: bun run lib/slot.check.ts && bun run lib/cards.check.ts && bun run lib/decode.check.ts && bun run place/place.check.ts && bun run gal/mmu.check.ts && bun run gal/jedec.check.ts && bun run gal/jedec/cupl.check.ts && bun run gal/video3/v3lane.check.ts && bun run gal/video3/regmap.check.ts && bun run gal/storage/storage.check.ts && bun run gal/storage/census.ts && bun run gal/audio.check.ts && bun run gal/arom.check.ts && bun run gal/fold.check.ts && bun run gal/pins.check.ts && bun run gal/reach.check.ts && bun run lib/docs.check.ts
scripts.check:storage: bun run gal/storage/storage.check.ts && bun run gal/storage/census.ts
scripts.check:netlist: bun run lib/netlist.check.ts && bun run lib/netlist.check.ts dist/cards/video/circuit.json
scripts.check:sim: cd gal && verilator --binary --timing -Wall -Wno-DECLFILENAME --top-module mmu_tb mmu.v mmu_tb.sv -o mmu_tb && ./obj_dir/mmu_tb && verilator --binary --timing -Wall -Wno-DECLFILENAME --top-module clkdec_tb clkdec.v clkdec_tb.sv -o clkdec_tb && ./obj_dir/clkdec_tb
scripts.build: for f in mainboard/mainboard.circuit.tsx cards/*.circuit.tsx; do echo "-- $f"; tsci build "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.build:all: npm run gen:pld && npm run build && npm run check && npm run check:netlist && npm run check:sim && npm run check:video && npm run check:machine && npm run check:audio:all
scripts.check:sim:audio: bun run gal/verilog/gen.ts && TBS=audio sh gal/verilog/run.sh
scripts.check:sim:board: bun run gal/verilog/gen.ts && TBS=mainboard sh gal/verilog/run.sh
scripts.check:modplay: bun run gal/verilog/gen.ts && sh gal/verilog/run-modplay.sh "$(sh gal/verilog/probes.sh)/14_fourchan.mod" 2
scripts.check:audio:all: npm run check:sim:audio && npm run check:oracle && npm run check:modplay
